integrity: The mathematical argument consists of a rational-function Laurent obstruction, an exact principal-ideal kernel calculation, Hermitian polarization, polynomial interpolation, and rank-two compactness. Finite arithmetic checks are supplementary, not universal proofs. No external expert or formal certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact profile dimensions and generic optimal linear profile interpolation are established, not a minimum nonlinear phase-retrieval sample count. Fixed-design inverse stability is qualitative only, with no uniform conditioning bound. The statement concerns real polynomial graphs and complex polynomial signals, not arbitrary smooth curves or entire functions. Earlier results cover the parabolic special case and analogous algebraic curves; broader unindexed priority remains possible.
title: Polynomial-graph phase retrieval: a complete affine-versus-curved dichotomy and exact profile dimension
